events.name: Bash
events.head: Check worktree state and chain summaries
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git status --short | head -20 && git log --oneline -5 && git fetch -q origin && git log --oneline HEAD..origin/main | wc -l && git log --oneline origin/t300-ruled-out-cleanup -1 2>/dev/null; cat /tmp/chain-t300/summary.txt 2>/dev/null | tail -20; echo ---; cat /tmp/chain-t300-base/summary.txt | tail -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check unpushed commits and chain logs
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git log --oneline origin/t300-ruled-out-cleanup..HEAD | head; ls -la --time-style=+%m-%d_%H:%M /tmp/chain-t300/summary.txt /tmp/chain-t300-base/summary.txt 2>/dev/null || stat -f '%Sm %N' /tmp/chain-t300/summary.txt /tmp/chain-t300-base/summary.txt; wc -l /tmp/chain-t300-base/summary.txt; ls /tmp/chain-t300/ | head -30; cat /tmp/chain-t300/export-site.log 2>/dev/null | tail -15

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check running chains and merge origin/main
events.input: $ ps aux | grep -E 'run-chain|wt-t300|chain-t300' | grep -v grep | head; ls -d /tmp/wt-t300-base /private/tmp/wt-*base* 2>/dev/null; cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git merge -q --no-edit origin/main 2>&1 | tail -5; git log --oneline -1; git status --short | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check time, listeners, run-chain options
events.input: $ date; ps aux | grep -E 'probe-|run-chain|vendor-sim|8794|8802' | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $9, $11, $12, $13, $14}' | head; lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN | awk '{print $2,$9}' | grep -E ':(88|87|89)[0-9][0-9]' | sort -u | head -20; sed -n 1,80p /private/tmp/wt-t300/app/scripts/run-chain.sh | grep -nE 'PORT|SIM|quick|usage|^#' | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Trace parent of base centre process
events.input: $ ps -o pid,ppid,lstart,command -p 43347 | cut -c1-200; P=$(ps -o ppid= -p 43347); ps -o pid,ppid,command -p $P | cut -c1-250; P2=$(ps -o ppid= -p $P); ps -o pid,ppid,command -p $P2 | cut -c1-250; ls /tmp/ | grep -iE 'chain|t300'

events.text: Checking the leftover baseline stack from the prior run, then running the branch checks.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect previous run stack logs
events.input: $ cd /tmp; stat -f '%Sm %N' t300-base-chain.log t300b-centre.log t300b-sim.log t300-chain.log t300-centre.log t300-sim.log t300-admin-url; tail -5 t300-base-chain.log; tail -3 t300b-sim.log; cat t300-centre.pid t300-sim.pid; head -c 120 t300-admin-url; echo; grep -n 'wrangler dev\|8800\|8810\|8801' -r /tmp/t300*.log 2>/dev/null | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find running chain processes
events.input: $ ps -axo pid,ppid,lstart,command | grep -E 'run-chain|probe-|serve.py|wt-t300' | grep -v grep | cut -c1-180; echo; tail -c 600 /tmp/t300-base-chain.log; echo; ls -la /tmp/chain-t300-base/ | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read baseline probe failures and chain setup
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300-base && git log --oneline -1 && git rev-parse origin/main | cut -c1-8; tail -6 /tmp/chain-t300-base/probe-domain-chain.log; echo ---; tail -6 /tmp/chain-t300-base/probe-day1.log; ps -p 43745 -o command= | cut -c1-120; sed -n 14,28p /private/tmp/wt-t300/app/scripts/run-chain.sh; sed -n 54,70p /private/tmp/wt-t300/app/scripts/run-chain.sh

events.name: Bash
events.head: Learn sim ports and domain-chain failure
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && grep -nE 'argv|PORT|environ' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -8; grep -nE 'reset' cloud/scripts/vendor-sim.py | head -5; head -30 /tmp/chain-t300-base/probe-domain-chain.log | cut -c1-200; grep -n 'wrangler dev\|--var' cloud/package.json cloud/scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | head -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Stop orphan base centre, update base worktree
events.input: $ kill 43324 43347 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; ps -p 43348 >/dev/null && kill 43348; cd /private/tmp/wt-t300-base && git status --short | head -3; git checkout -q --detach origin/main && git log --oneline -1; head -20 /private/tmp/wt-t300/cloud/scripts/build.sh | grep -E '^#'

events.name: Write
events.head: /tmp/t300-run.sh

events.text: Starting a private stack for the branch and running the chain against it, then the baseline.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Make sim reset restart the simulator
events.input: $ cd /tmp && python3 - <<'EOF'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run branch and baseline chains on private stacks
events.input: $ bash /tmp/t300-both.sh > /tmp/t300-both.log 2>&1

events.text: While that runs, checking the done_when grep and the code items directly.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run done_when grep for ruled-out names
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && for n in godaddy "microsoft 365" m365 instantly sendgrid zerobounce neverbounce builtwith heyreach calendly apollo "whatsapp cloud"; do echo "== $n: $(git grep -il "$n" -- app/src cloud/src workshop-plan/survey.html | tr '\n' ' ')"; done; ls cloud/src/connectors/ | tr '\n' ' '; echo; ls cloud/src/jobs-m365.ts 2>&1 | tail -1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Broader grep for stale references
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git grep -ilE 'godaddy|microsoft 365|\bm365\b|sendgrid|zerobounce|neverbounce|builtwith|heyreach|calendly|whatsapp cloud' -- cloud app/scripts workshop-plan ':!workshop-plan/tasks' ':!app/src/lib/examples/data' | head -40; echo ---; git grep -ilE 'sendgrid|m365|godaddy' origin/main -- app/src cloud/src | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check admin, dashboard, retired disconnect, verification copy
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git grep -inE 'sendgrid|m365|microsoft|verif' -- cloud/admin-ui/admin.js cloud/src/dashboard.ts | head; echo ---RETIRED; git grep -nE 'RETIRED|retired' -- cloud/src app/src/app app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | head -15; echo ---VERIFY; git grep -niE 'verified list|verify every email|neverbounce|paid (email )?verif' -- app/src cloud/src workshop-plan/playbook.html workshop-plan/*.html ':!app/src/lib/examples/data' | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Narrow checks on retired backend and verification copy
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git grep -ciE 'sendgrid|m365|microsoft' -- cloud/admin-ui/admin.js cloud/src/dashboard.ts; git grep -nE 'retired' -- cloud/src | cut -c1-220 | head -12; echo ---VERIFY; git grep -noiE '.{60}(verified list|verify every email|zerobounce|neverbounce|paid (email )?verif).{60}' -- app/src cloud/src workshop-plan/playbook.html app/src/content ':!app/src/lib/examples/data' | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read disconnect route and UI, scan verify phrasing
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && sed -n 428,442p cloud/src/agentic.ts | cut -c1-240; sed -n 150,175p app/src/app/onboarding/centre/agent.tsx | cut -c1-220; git grep -noiE '.{50}(verif)[a-z]* (every|each|your|the) (email|list|address).{50}' -- app/src workshop-plan/playbook.html ':!app/src/lib/examples/data' | head -8

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check probes, card copy, survey state
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git grep -lE 'retired' -- app/scripts cloud/scripts | head; git grep -noiE '.{40}verified.{40}' -- app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | head -5; grep -ciE 'godaddy|sendgrid|apollo|builtwith' workshop-plan/survey.html; ls workshop-plan/ | grep -i survey; git log --oneline -3 -- workshop-plan/survey.html

events.text: Code items look in place; now proving the denylist probe and the retired-key disconnect.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-visual-tools and find retired probe
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300/app && head -15 scripts/probe-visual-tools.mjs | grep -E '^//|^\s*\*' ; git grep -nE 'retired' -- scripts/probe-stack.mjs | cut -c1-200 | head -5; node scripts/probe-visual-tools.mjs > /tmp/t300-pvt.log 2>&1; echo rc=$?; tail -3 /tmp/t300-pvt.log

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare probe-visual-tools on main baseline
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300-base/app && node scripts/probe-visual-tools.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3; cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git log -1 --format='%h %s' -- workshop-plan/index.html; git log origin/main -1 --format='%h %s' -- workshop-plan/index.html; git grep -c Unipile -- workshop-plan/index.html; git grep -c Unipile origin/main -- workshop-plan/index.html

events.text: The Unipile failure happens on main too (it's in the hub review data, not a T-300 tool). Next, the planted-name test.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Plant Calendly, check probe fails, revert
events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && cp app/src/lib/curriculum.ts /tmp/t300-cur.bak && echo '// Book a call on Calendly' >> app/src/lib/curriculum.ts && (cd app && node scripts/probe-visual-tools.mjs 2>&1 | grep -iE 'calendly|FAIL' | head -3); cp /tmp/t300-cur.bak app/src/lib/curriculum.ts; git status --short app/src/lib/curriculum.ts; cat /tmp/t300-both.log | tail -5; ls /tmp/chain-t300/summary.txt /tmp/chain-t300-base/summary.txt 2>&1; cat /tmp/chain-t300.head

events.text: The probe catches the planted Calendly and the plant is reverted. Waiting for the branch chain to finish.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for branch chain to finish
events.input: $ for i in $(seq 115); do grep -q done /tmp/chain-t300.head && break; sleep 5; done; cat /tmp/chain-t300.head; tail -25 /tmp/chain-t300/summary.txt

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect branch chain failures
events.input: $ cd /tmp/chain-t300; ls | head -40; for f in probe-domain-chain probe-day1 probe-day2 probe-context; do echo "== $f"; grep -E '✗|FAIL|Error|Timeout' $f.log 2>/dev/null | head -3 | cut -c1-220; done

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show stack, shapes, workshop failure lines
events.input: $ cd /tmp/chain-t300; for f in probe-stack probe-shapes probe-workshop; do echo "== $f"; grep -E '✗|FAIL' $f.log | head -4 | cut -c1-200; done; grep -B2 -A3 'locator.click' probe-domain-chain.log | grep -iE 'getBy|locator\(' | head -2 | cut -c1-200

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for the baseline chain to finish
events.input: $ for i in $(seq 115); do grep -q done /tmp/chain-t300-base.head 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 5; done; cat /tmp/chain-t300-base.head; cat /tmp/chain-t300-base/summary.txt | cut -c1-60

events.name: Bash
events.head: Wait for baseline and list its failures
events.input: $ for i in $(seq 115); do grep -q anonymity /tmp/chain-t300-base/summary.txt 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 5; done; cd /tmp/chain-t300-base; tail -5 summary.txt | cut -c1-60; for f in probe-domain-chain probe-day1 probe-day2 probe-context probe-stack probe-shapes probe-workshop; do echo "== $f"; grep -E '✗|FAIL|waiting for locator' $f.log 2>/dev/null | head -4 | cut -c1-150; done

events.text: The only difference is in probe-workshop: 4 failures on the branch vs 3 on main. Checking which one is extra.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Diff workshop probe failures branch vs base
events.input: $ diff <(grep -E 'FAIL' /tmp/chain-t300/probe-workshop.log) <(grep -E 'FAIL' /tmp/chain-t300-base/probe-workshop.log); grep -n -B3 -A6 'Save my seat" goes through checkout' /tmp/chain-t300/probe-workshop.log | cut -c1-200 | head -14; grep -n 'Save my seat' /tmp/chain-t300-base/probe-workshop.log | cut -c1-200

events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && git diff --stat origin/main...HEAD -- app/src/app/masterclass app/src/components/masterclass app/src/app/api | tail -5; git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD | grep -iE 'masterclass|checkout|optin|opt-in' | head

events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300 && grep -nE 'SITE=|4322|serve|http.server' app/scripts/run-chain.sh | head -8; lsof -ti:4322 | head -2

events.input: $ cd /private/tmp/wt-t300/app && out=$(bash scripts/export-static.sh /tantra-workshop-live/site https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/site 2>/dev/null | tail -1) && S=/tmp/stage-mirror-4322/tantra-workshop-live && rsync -a --delete "$out/" "$S/site/" && echo staged && for n in 1 2; do BASE=http://localhost:4322/tantra-workshop-live/site node scripts/probe-workshop.mjs > /tmp/t300-pw$n.log 2>&1; grep -E 'FAIL|CTA #2' /tmp/t300-pw$n.log | cut -c1-120; echo ---; done
